thread.title: Analysts Offer Insights on Consumer Goods Companies: Apple (AAPL), Nvidia (NVDA) and Silicon Motion (SIMO)

author: Catie Powers
title: Analysts Offer Insights on Consumer Goods Companies: Apple (AAPL), Nvidia (NVDA) and Silicon Motion (SIMO)
text:
Catie Powers - January 28, 2019, 6:53 PM EDT SHARE ON:
There’s a lot to be optimistic about in the Consumer Goods sector as 3 analysts just weighed in on Apple ( AAPL ), Nvidia ( NVDA ) and Silicon Motion ( SIMO ) with bullish sentiments.
Apple (AAPL)
RBC Capital analyst Amit Daryanani maintained a Buy rating on Apple today and set a price target of $185 . The company’s shares opened today at $156.30, close to its 52-week low of $142.
According to TipRanks.com , Daryanani is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 14.3% and a 61.0% success rate. Daryanani covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Dell Technologies Inc, Ichor Holdings Ltd, and Xperi Corporation.
Apple has an analyst consensus of Moderate Buy, with a price target consensus of $183.98, which is a 17.7% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 14, UBS also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $180 price target.
Nvidia (NVDA)
In a report released today, Matt Ramsay from Cowen & Co. maintained a Buy rating on Nvidia, with a price target of $215 . The company’s shares opened today at $138.01, close to its 52-week low of $124.46.
According to TipRanks.com , Ramsay is a top 100 analyst with an average return of 22.8% and a 62.1% success rate. Ramsay covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Cirrus Logic, Broadcom, and Xilinx.
The word on The Street in general, suggests a Moderate Buy analyst consensus rating for Nvidia with a $212.96 average price target, a 54.3% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 14, Evercore ISI also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $275 price target.
Silicon Motion (SIMO)
In a report released today, Anthony Stoss from Craig-Hallum maintained a Buy rating on Silicon Motion, with a price target of $52 . The company’s shares opened today at $38.11.
According to TipRanks.com , Stoss is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 12.0% and a 60.6% success rate. Stoss covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Digi International Inc, Akoustis Technologies, and Skyworks Solutions.
The word on The Street in general, suggests a Strong Buy analyst consensus rating for Silicon Motion with a $47.77 average price target, a 25.3% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 17, Needham also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $50 price target.
